description:
Activate Mairsil using Asmodeus' first ability by paying {B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw seven cards.
Activate Mairsil using Pack Rat's ability by paying {B} and discarding a card.
Holding priority, activate Mairsil by discarding a card and sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Mairsil ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Mairsil.
Repeat from step 2 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.
